description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Land Parcel in Thirunelweli West, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna District - Cad. Map No. 910001 and to 13 other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. These notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land parcel registrations across various districts in Sri Lanka. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, ownership claims, and title settlement procedures.
